## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List relevant checks and any limitations. For experiments, include the config,
source revisions, hardware, seed, and measured results.

## Checklist

- [ ] Targets `develop` for a feature, or follows the documented release/hotfix flow.
- [ ] Includes relevant tests and documentation.
- [ ] Contains no credentials, raw datasets, model weights, or notebook outputs.
- [ ] Separates measured results from expectations.
